questions.question: Group evaluation of design ideas should be based on:
A good reason for a cross under rigidity is:
options: Single thin diagonals in the upper panels and no internal bracing, so it may twist

questions.question: Every design idea should be given:
options: A mark out of ten only
At least two advantages and two disadvantages

questions.question: A tree canopy on a tower is an advantage for visual impact but a disadvantage for:
Who makes the final decision about which idea a learner develops?
options: The learner who owns the design

questions.question: Criticism should be aimed at:
A good way to phrase a criticism is:
options: The base is narrow for the height, so it may topple
You made the base too narrow

questions.question: When receiving criticism you should first:
options: Listen to the whole comment and write it down

questions.question: If you reject a comment you should:
options: Record your reason for rejecting it

questions.question: Borrowing a classmate's idea is acceptable when:
options: It is acknowledged and the final design remains your own synthesis

questions.question: Improvement after evaluation means:
options: Specific recorded changes to the existing design, each with a reason

questions.question: Why should the original sketch not be erased?
options: The improvement is only visible if before and after both exist

questions.question: After improving, the design should be:
options: Checked against the full specification list again

questions.question: If a specification cannot be met without breaking a constraint, you should:
options: Say so and propose a revised specification with a reason

questions.question: Adding X bracing to the lower panels in response to a rigidity comment is an example of:
options: A recorded change with a reason tied to the brief

subtopics.title: Judging Against the Brief, Not Against Taste

questions.question: The specifications go:
options: Across the top of the table

questions.question: The base is narrow so it may topple is better than I do not like it because:
options: It points to something that can be checked and fixed

questions.question: Who decides which of your two ideas to develop?

subtopics.title: How to Say It and How to Hear It

questions.question: Say what works first because:
options: The designer needs to know which features to keep

questions.question: Decide what to change:
options: Later, on your own, after considering every comment

questions.question: The teacher also marks:
options: Whether you took part and gave good reasons

subtopics.title: Making It Better, Not Starting Over

questions.question: A canopy that adds top weight is answered by:
options: A thicker base plate and webs at the base corners

questions.question: The paragraph after improving should say which comments were accepted, which were rejected and:
options: What was borrowed and from where

questions.question: Starting a completely new design after criticism is:
options: Not what the process values; adapt the existing one

questions.question: A fresh column in the table after improving should show mostly:
